normative_rules: Artifact integrity establishes byte identity only; it does not establish correctness, entailment, novelty, or provenance quality.
Control-plane authorization must use claim_epistemic_status=not_applicable unless a separate public inference supplies evidence and authority.
Scope widening and epistemic upgrades require an explicit public warrant, supporting evidence, and authority.
A refuted or quarantined claim cannot become validated through a receipt or workflow exit decision alone.
